text:
Tori (Sales): Halcyon just sent an RFP. Top asks: private VPC, FIPS HSM BYOK, 12mo audit log retention, POC for embeddings+chat, capability matrix, and 3-tier pricing (reserved/committed/burst). Questionnaire attached.

ALEXA (Halcyon): Hi Tori 12 quick numbers: steady 120 QPS embeddings, nightly spikes to 450 for reindex. Embedding dim 512. EU data residency required. Need pen-test + SOC2.

Sam (Solutions): Got it. Proposed POC scope: 1) private cluster in eu-west-1 w/ VPC peering 2) HSM BYOK test (Thales/PKCS11 path) 3) perf runs at 100/200/450 QPS 4) fidelity evals on your corpus 5) SIEM export trial. Est. prep 7 business days, run 5 days.

Priya (Security): I'll own the RFI rows for crypto, key lifecycle, logging, and SIEM export. Note: full content export requires DPA amendment; we can offer anonymized token metrics and full access logs. Attaching: "soc2_snapshot.pdf", "pen-test-2025-summary.pdf", "hsm-byo-arch.pdf".

Lina (Product): Model guidance: recommend embed-512-int8 for latency/cost and embed-512-fp16 for fidelity runs. Chat: use latency-optimized int8 variant. I'll add a model-fidelity/cost column in the matrix. Expect ~15-20% lower memory with int8.

Sam (Solutions): POC infra snippet for infra team:

```
redwood_poc:
  region: eu-west-1
  mode: private
  vpc_peering: true
  nodes: 6
  node_type: a2
  embed_dim: 512
  quant_profile: int8
  kms: thales-emulator
  monitoring: datadog
```

Tori (Sales): ALEXA 12 can you confirm whether Halcyon needs subcontractor list disclosure and the retention window for audit logs? Also any budget targets?

ALEXA (Halcyon): Subcontractor list: yes, limited disclosure OK under NDA. Retention: 12 months. Budget: looking for comps between reserved 12mo vs burst; rough sticker needed.

Marta (Legal): If we disclose subcontractor lists we need an NDA addendum. DPA will need to reflect EU residency + 12mo retention. If token-level content is exported, require explicit consent and SOW clauses. I'll draft templates.

Priya (Security): We'll prepare RFI answers and the attachables. We'll offer SIEM export via secure S3 (encrypted) or syslog push. Token-level export: can be redacted or suppressed.

Sam (Solutions): Pricing sketch: Reserved cluster for steady 120 QPS + buffer estimated $XXk/mo; committed 12mo discount options; burst taxed per-token. I'll produce three scenarios (min, recommended, HA) and add to the quote.

Tori (Sales): Plan: Sam -> finalize POC runbook + perf matrix + pricing scenarios; Priya -> RFI answers + attach docs; Lina -> capability matrix with model guidance; Marta -> NDA/DPA templates. I'll assemble and send Halcyon packet by EOD Thursday.

ci-bot: Branch "halcyon-rfp" status: infra lint OK, CI tests passed.

ALEXA (Halcyon): Thanks 12 we'll review and propose POC weeks. Quick ask 12 include a short method for measuring embedding drift.

Lina (Product): Will include embedding-drift checks (cosine baselines, recall@k) in the deliverables.

Tori (Sales): Perfect. Keep updates brief here. :thumbsup:
